text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"While watching over Biko Pegasus's dance lesson
in the studio..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Yah!
Here I go! Signature pose! Bam!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. I did it again!
Mmph...!
choice_data_list: That was kinda like a hero show, huh.
That was kinda like a hero show, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I know!
It seems she gets like this whenever she
gets super excited...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, it's the Winning Live, you know!?
How can I not get super hyped upー!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I don't want to cause trouble for everyone dancing with me...
Dammit! What should I do?!
choice_data_list: Let's learn from the Sentai heroes' dance!
I think you're great just the way you are!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
A sentai hero dance...?
Oh! You mean the one from the ending credits?!
choice_data_list: Even they dance to the beat around them, you know?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, that's true! Teamwork is important for a hero, too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Red, Blue, Pink, and even that goofy Yellow all dance together in the ending, after all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer!
You helped me remember what's truly important for a hero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...I know! If only I had
friends who'd dance with me, too—"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Answering the call of justice, I'm here!
Biko Red!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I won't let anyone get away with causing trouble in the dorms!
Hishi Ama Blue!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Captivating you with world-class charm!
Ho ho ho ho! It's Seeking Pink!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Delicious food makes you buono too~♪
I'm Akebono Yellow~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
W-Why is Windy-chan on this side?!
Windy-chan is on the enemy side!
Graaah! ...Windy Black!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Thanks for gathering here today!
Alright, here we go!
Crimson sun~ shining bright~ thank you for your hard work~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, after practicing dancing together with everyone, Biko Pegasus learned how to dance in sync with those around her.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Really?! But I started doing
whatever I wanted halfway through...
choice_data_list: So, how did the fans react?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Um, that is—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Toh! Hyaaah!
Justice Biko, moving out!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Way to gooo!
Do your best, Justice Biko!
Show us more of your signature poses!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! Did ya see the hero run?!
Justice—Transform! Hyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
They seemed pretty excited though!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even though all I did in the second half was strike poses...
why was everyone so happy about it?!
choice_data_list: Because it was such a Biko-like live.
Because it was such a Biko-like live, you know.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh, is that so! So it's okay for me to just dance in my own way...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I don't want to cause trouble for anyone!
So I'll definitely memorize the choreography!
I won't do anything selfish!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
But... I still want to strike a victory pose!
I don't have to hold back on that, right?!
choice_data_list: That's the you the fans want to see.
That's the you the fans want to see.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Nnnrgh! Thank you, Trainer!
Now I know what to focus on for the live performance!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: All riiiight! I'm gonna practice tons for the Winning Live!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, having learned to dance in her own style,
Biko Pegasus hyped up the live performance
more than ever before.
